proposed_from.topic: Exact finite-sample locally private SATE design game. For N>=4 labeled units with arbitrary binary potential-outcome schedules, complete randomization of exactly m treated units, and a common noninteractive epsilon-local-DP channel protecting (W,Yobs), jointly minimize worst-schedule expected cardinality among randomized exact 1-alpha confidence sets for the finite-population SATE. Prove schedule-orbit reduction and sufficiency of the fourteen nonconstant four-input staircase patterns; formulate fixed-channel confidence inference as an exact primal-dual LP and common-channel optimization as an attained degree-N polynomial game; develop algebraic or positive-tolerance global certificates; and characterize the parameter cells and actual boundaries where a balanced design with randomized response after a nontrivial binary partition is globally optimal. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Exact derivations give the orbit generating-function kernel, fourteen-output Blackwell refinement, fixed-channel LP, and polynomial-dual global lower bounds. Independent exact reruns certify a nonbinary exclusion interval [999.9,1000.1], disprove the convex-utility shortcut, and bracket the unrestricted N=4, alpha=2/5, lambda=1000 value in [2.58227914,2.58228508], with every optimizer balanced for lambda>=1000; no exact literature collision was found, while consumer translation requires a hidden-assignment protocol. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Make the simultaneous lower certificate attain equality at a specified optimizing channel and continue it across a nontrivial parameter cell to identify an actual boundary of the balanced-binary equality set. EARLY KILL TEST: Reproduce the full fourteen-weight N=4 global bracket within 1e-5 and 100000 channel cells; this passed in one cell using 2,825,761 exact vertex-tensor bounds, so the next kill test is failure of optimizer-attaining certificate extraction. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/exp_private_sate_design_game.md.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction, Theorems 2 and 4 with the polytope proof in Section 7, and Section 6 discussion were read. The proof first bounds the output alphabet for convex utilities and then exposes staircase columns through a finite linear program.
seed_details.kernel: For \(N=4\), derive an optimizer-attaining primal--dual polynomial certificate on a nonempty \((\lambda,\alpha)\)-cell and use its sign-changing algebraic residual to locate an actual boundary of the balanced-binary equality set.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The staircase linear objective in Kairouz, Oh, and Viswanath is replaced by the lower envelope of exact confidence linear programs after a common channel is composed four times; the first new step is a simultaneous confidence-dual factorization whose residual is certified on a channel cell.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for exact locally private SATE confidence sets, common-channel polynomial games, and active-set phase-boundary continuation returned causal-LDP estimation, distributed-DP intervals, and generic polynomial optimization, but no occupied target--method pair.
seed_details.direct_evidence: Exact reruns verify a fourteen-pattern reduction, a width \(5.94\times 10^{-6}\) unrestricted bracket at \((N,\alpha,\lambda)=(4,2/5,1000)\), and strict exclusion of all balanced binary partitions on \([999.9,1000.1]\).
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Kairouz, Oh, and Viswanath because staircase utilities reduce to a finite linear program.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their reduction requires a convex column-separable utility, whereas the exact confidence value after fourfold channel composition is neither column-separable nor convex; an exact counterexample verifies the failed convexity premise.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction, Lemma 4 and its private-mean reduction proof, Theorem 6 and its central-limit proof, and Section 7 concluding remarks were read. The paper separates joint and customized privatization but works with population MSE and plug-in intervals.
seed_details.kernel: Characterize exactly when hiding assignment in a common local channel, revealing assignment, and permitting treatment-aware outcome channels have equal minimax exact SATE confidence risk, with a certified positive gap off the equality region.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the private-mean least-favorable subproblem in Ohnishi and Awan by a Blackwell comparison of finite transcript experiments indexed by complete potential-outcome schedules.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches pairing hidden assignment with exact randomization confidence and local privacy found joint privatization estimators and cryptographic trial protocols, but no equality-or-separation theorem for schedulewise exact confidence risk.
seed_details.direct_evidence: The orbit kernel distinguishes schedules with the same SATE, and the operational protocol difference is visible as the analyst sigma-field changes when assignment is hidden.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Blackwell ordering because revealing assignment is always more informative.
seed_details.rebuttal: One dominance direction is immediate, but equality and strictness require a complete characterization of when the extra assignment signal changes this composite-nuisance confidence decision game.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction, the pure-privacy staircase theorems and proofs, the approximate-privacy operational argument, and the discussion were read. The paper explicitly notes that its pure-privacy techniques do not transfer to approximate privacy.
seed_details.kernel: For four protected inputs, decide whether \((\varepsilon,\delta)\)-local privacy admits a finite universal Blackwell refinement for the exact SATE game, or exhibit a larger-output extreme channel with a strict exact-risk certificate.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The two-level conic layer decomposition of each pure-private column fails when additive \(\delta\)-slack permits input-dependent zeros; the replacement step must classify feasible perturbations of four-row approximate-private channels.
seed_details.destination_search: The destination search found complete approximate-private extreme-point classifications only for two and three inputs and new star configurations beyond that range, but no four-input causal decision result.
seed_details.direct_evidence: Rawat, Vajha, Kurri, and Sarwate prove the small-input classifications and place four inputs immediately beyond the characterized frontier.
seed_details.red_team: A generic finite-dimensional polytope argument already bounds the required output size.
seed_details.rebuttal: The union over arbitrary output alphabets is not a single fixed polytope, and approximate privacy admits extreme configurations whose output size can exceed the input size.

seed_details.anchor_read: Theorem 2, Theorem 4, their Section 7 proof, and the concluding discussion were read.
seed_details.kernel: Characterize the parameter region in which an optimal exact SATE channel can be chosen with at most four active staircase outputs, and construct a certified region requiring more than four otherwise.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Caratheodory-style output sparsity can no longer be invoked after the confidence rule is optimized, so one must analyze supports of the common-channel polynomial saddle directly.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for output-cardinality bounds under product-channel exact confidence loss found only convex-utility or single-draw divergence results.
seed_details.direct_evidence: Four-ary randomized response is a strong feasible witness, but the verified nonconvexity result removes the standard extreme-point shortcut.
seed_details.red_team: At most four outputs follows from vertices of the four-row staircase normalization polytope.
seed_details.rebuttal: Minimizing the optimized fourfold confidence value over that polytope need not attain a vertex because the negative value is not convex.
seed_details.decision: dropped after ranking because the required-support side has weaker evidence than the boundary seed

seed_details.anchor_read: The randomized-experiment setup, minimax lower bound, estimator theorems, and concluding mechanism-design discussion were read.
seed_details.kernel: Derive a nondegenerate \((N,\alpha,\lambda)\)-region on which balanced complete randomization minimizes exact private SATE confidence cardinality among all treatment counts.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace population treatment-probability optimization with comparison of finite hypergeometric orbit experiments across integer treatment counts.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for optimal allocation under local privacy found asymptotic variance and distributed-privacy budget allocation, not schedulewise exact minimax cardinality.
seed_details.direct_evidence: The exact identity-experiment lower bound excludes \(m=1,3\) for \(N=4\), \(\alpha=2/5\), and every \(\lambda\ge 1000\).
seed_details.red_team: Balance follows from the reflection \(m\leftrightarrow N-m\).
seed_details.rebuttal: Reflection gives equality only between paired allocations and supplies no monotonicity toward the center.
seed_details.decision: dropped after deepening because the available proof is restricted to one four-unit regime

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction, finite-sample mechanism-design discussion in the conclusion, and the frequentist interval construction were read.
seed_details.kernel: Certify a practically conventional coverage cell, including \(1-\alpha=0.95\), on which every binary-partition randomized-response channel is strictly suboptimal for exact SATE confidence cardinality.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace plug-in Wald width with an exact schedulewise confidence linear program and a uniform binary-channel dual lower certificate.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for high-coverage exact local-private SATE comparisons found no nonbinary-mechanism theorem.
seed_details.direct_evidence: A strict nonbinary interval is exact-certified at \(1-\alpha=0.6\), but no evidence yet transfers it to \(0.95\).
seed_details.red_team: The existing \(60\%\)-coverage witness should persist by continuity to \(95\%\).
seed_details.rebuttal: Continuity is local in \(\alpha\) and gives no bridge across a change of \(0.35\), where the confidence active set can change repeatedly.
seed_details.decision: dropped because the evidence is too remote from conventional coverage

seed_details.anchor_read: The high- and low-privacy mechanism theorems, their proofs, and the discussion of correlated data were read.
seed_details.kernel: Derive a large-\(N\) phase limit for the exact-cardinality optimal channel and treatment fraction, with a finite-sample approximation bound to the limiting design game.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The i.i.d. divergence objective must be replaced by a large-deviation or local-asymptotic analysis of hypergeometric schedule orbits under an optimized exact-confidence decision.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches pairing local-private experiment design with finite-population exact-confidence asymptotics found minimax MSE and distributed-DP interval-width results only.
seed_details.direct_evidence: The finite polynomial game exists for every \(N\), but its dimension and certificate cost grow rapidly and no limiting variational form is yet derived.
seed_details.red_team: This is a routine asymptotic approximation to the finite game.
seed_details.rebuttal: The adversarial schedule orbit and changing confidence active sets prevent direct reduction to an i.i.d. divergence or a fixed smooth loss.
seed_details.decision: dropped as infeasible for the first specialization

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction, Theorem 1 on Bayes--minimax duality, the Monte Carlo convergence theorem and proof, and the final proof discussion were read.
seed_details.kernel: Characterize exactly when auxiliary randomization strictly reduces minimax expected cardinality relative to deterministic exact SATE confidence sets under a fixed local channel.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace continuous parameter-space test inversion by the finite box of conditional inclusion probabilities and compare it with its integral vertices.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for integrality gaps in exact randomized confidence sets under local privacy found general randomized confidence constructions but no SATE-channel characterization.
seed_details.direct_evidence: At an uninformative channel, randomization attains \((2N+1)(1-\alpha)\), whereas a deterministic exact rule must report the full grid.
seed_details.red_team: The result is a one-line consequence of convexifying deterministic confidence rules.
seed_details.rebuttal: Strictness at the uninformative boundary is immediate, so a publishable characterization would require the full channel-dependent integrality frontier; current evidence does not support that frontier.
seed_details.decision: dropped because the strongest available fact is boundary-trivial

seed_details.anchor_read: The common noninteractive model, Section 6 discussion of interactive extensions, and the Blackwell operational argument for approximate privacy were read.
seed_details.kernel: Determine whether interaction or public assignment-dependent channel selection strictly lowers exact minimax SATE confidence cardinality relative to a common noninteractive channel.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The product of a single common channel must be replaced by a transcript kernel adapted to prior privatized reports, eliminating the finite monomial lifting.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for interactive local-private causal randomization inference found interactive testing separations but no finite-population exact SATE confidence design.
seed_details.direct_evidence: Protocol-information results show interaction can matter in local testing, but no tractable exact reduction is available for this schedule game.
seed_details.red_team: Known interactive local-privacy separations transfer directly.
seed_details.rebuttal: Those separations concern distribution testing or estimation, not schedulewise exact coverage under complete randomization and a causal estimand.
seed_details.decision: dropped as too broad for a first paper
